description: Coastal County Snapshots is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Coastal Management. Generate a report for any coastal county that shows complex data in brief stories, complete with charts and graphs. Local officials can use the snapshots to assess their county’s resilience to flooding. The snapshots can also serve as an educational tool when working with governing bodies and citizen groups. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Cultural and Community Services, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
